input.quote: (c) ASSIGNMENT. Licensee may not assign this Agreement or assign, sublicense and/or transfer in any manner its license rights hereunder in whole or in part without Licensor's prior written consent.
input.rationale: Article XXIV(c) bars any Licensee assignment without Licensor consent with no affiliate or M&A carve-out, and imposes no restriction at all on Licensor assignment, so it fails even the fallback (no mutual successor right, no notice mechanic, no reasonableness standard). Article XX(a) compounds this by automatically terminating the Agreement and all of our licences on our Change of Control unless Licensor consents, with Licensor deemed reasonable in refusing on competitive or subjective "adversely effected" grounds — squarely walk-away territory. We therefore move to the preferred position: consent-free Licensee assignment to an Affiliate (defined in §1.1) or M&A successor, consent (not unreasonably withheld) for Licensor assignments with no assignment to our competitors, and no Licensor termination right on our change of control. The deleted change-of-control carve-out in §XXIV(c) also cross-referenced a non-existent "Section 13.4(a)"; the CHANGE OF CONTROL definition is retained. The Article XXII right of first refusal on a sale/merger is a separate commercial term and is not flagged here.

proposal.summary: Allow Licensee assignment to Affiliates/successors without consent, restrict Licensor assignment, and remove automatic termination on Licensee change of control.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We need the standard M&A and affiliate carve-out for our own assignments, a consent requirement (not unreasonably withheld) on Licensor assignments with no assignment to our competitors, and removal of the automatic termination of the Agreement and our licences on our change of control; the deleted change-of-control carve-out also cross-referenced a non-existent Section 13.4(a). We can discuss a mutual successor-assignment-on-notice fallback if preferred.

ops.newText: Licensee may assign this Agreement, without Licensor's consent, to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets; any other assignment by Licensee requires Licensor's prior written consent. Licensor may not assign this Agreement without Licensee's prior written consent, which will not be unreasonably withheld, and may not assign this Agreement to a competitor of Licensee. Any attempt to assign this Agreement or assign, sublicense and/or transfer in any manner Licensee's license rights hereunder without such consent will be void and of no effect.

ops.oldText: (a) Upon the occurrence of any Change of Control (as defined below) this Agreement and all Licensee's rights and licenses hereunder shall automatically terminate unless, prior to the occurrence of such Change of Control, Licensor has consented to such Change of Control in a writing executed by an officer of Licensor; provided that Licensor will not unreasonably withhold its consent to the consummation of a Change of Control. For purposes of the preceding sentence, Licensor will be deemed to have reasonably withheld its consent to a Change of Control if any person or entity who would acquire direct or indirect control (as defined below) of Licensee pursuant to such Change of Control then conducts a business that is directly or indirectly competitive with a business then conducted by Licensor or any of its Affiliates and/or Licensor reasonably believes that Licensor's interests will be adversely effected by the continuing of this Agreement upon such a Change in Control.
ops.newText: (a) A Change of Control (as defined below) shall not give Licensor any right to terminate this Agreement or any of Licensee's rights or licenses hereunder.
